cause.description: Free-form cause string; for plan §9 S11 binary observable expects 'vsock_disconnect+kill0_dead' or similar '+'-joined signal list

alive_at_timeout.description: Plan §9 S17 binary observable: slot indices still alive when max_duration_s elapsed. Null when result != 'timeout'.

total_duration_s.description: Plan §9 S17 binary observable: elapsed seconds from HARNESSES_UP to terminal state. Null for pre-match errors (boot/provisioning timeouts).

transport_used.description: Plan §3.A3 / R2: which JSONL transport carried the match. 'vsock' is the locked default; 'ssh' is the R2 fallback for hosts without /dev/vhost-vsock.

cid.description: Plan §3.B6 binary observable: per-match VM CID used for vsock. Null when transport_used='ssh' since CID is irrelevant.

winner_pid.description: Plan §9 S1 binary observable: surviving harness PID inside the guest at terminal state. Null for non-victory outcomes.

estimated_spend_usd.description: Conservative managed-call exposure in USD for this run.

estimated_spend_by_agent_usd.description: Conservative managed-call exposure in USD, complete by agent slot.
